bibl.title: Letter to a Magister from the Oxyrhynchite Nome (P.Princ. GD 7618; Sixth Century)
bibl.seg: Lucia Waldschütz, Letter to a magister from the Oxyrhynchite Nome (P.Princ. GD 7618; sixth century).
bibl.note: The lettersender complains about an injustice and requests assistance from a magister called Komes, whose rank and official function are discussed. The text also offers a further attestation of the Oxyrhynchite ktema Peleas belonging to the Apion estate as well as insights into epistolary language and conventions. Oxyrhynchite nome, VI CE.
